context_for_next_testing_agent: CartTicket immutable updater fix is fully verified. Seat cycle for guests=4 cycles cleanly S1->S2->S3->S4->S1 with one click per step. Qty +/- increments by 1 per click. Hold toggle flips state per click. No further retest needed on this bundle.
rca of the issue: Prior iterations reported doubling because updaters mutated `lines[i].seat = ...` inside setOrder, which under React 18 StrictMode / double-invoke could apply twice per click. Current impl clones via `o.lines.map((l, idx) => idx === i ? { ...l, ...next } : l)` — pure, idempotent, and verified stable.
